description: Generated REST client for the Bonder API, with a token-renewing HTTP handler. Used by Bonder integrations and on-premise sync agents.
releaseNotes:
1.3.0 — first regeneration since 1.2.9 (May 2025). 76 commits of API surface;
the public type count goes from 293 to 502 and BonderClient gains 637 methods.

BREAKING — read before upgrading:

* Update2Async now targets a different endpoint. In 1.2.9 it updated a support
  case; it now updates an ErrorClusterExecution. Support-case update moved to
  UpdateSupportCaseAsync(Guid, SupportCaseUpdateDto). NSwag renumbers the
  UpdateNAsync overloads whenever routes are added, so prefer the named
  methods (UpdateSupportCaseAsync, UpdateSupportCaseWithDefaultsAsync) over
  UpdateNAsync, which will keep shifting between releases.
* Support-activity CRUD is gone: CreateSupportActivityAsync,
  UpdateSupportActivityAsync, DeleteSupportActivityAsync and
  GetSupportActivityAsync no longer exist. Use GetSupportActivitiesAsync /
  GetAllSupportActivitiesAsync, plus the SupportActivityFile methods.
* The generated VerticalCodes.Bonder.NetClient.TimeSpan DTO is removed.
  ActionDto.TemplateDuration is now a string, and Extensions.RetryActionAsync
  takes a System.TimeSpan.
* CreateBonderClient takes a fifth Guid parameter.
* Nullability: CreateProductDto.ProductCatalog and UpdateProductDto.ProductCatalog
  are now bool? (the server defaults them when omitted), and
  SupportActivityDto.SupportCaseId / SupportActivityCommandDto.SupportCaseId are
  now Guid?. Both DTOs also gain SupportByPartner.
* Removed members: SupportCaseWorkReportDto.AttachFinalizationChecklist,
  SupportMessageDto.Viewers, UserDto.ViewedSupportMessages.
* Changed signatures: SendMailAsync takes an extra bool?, VerifyInviteAsync
  returns bool instead of TenantDto, GetUserHeaderImageAsync takes a string,
  UpdateChecklistExecutionAsync returns ChecklistExecutionDto, and
  GetAnalysisAsync and CreateTenantAuthenticationsAsync were re-signatured.

ADDED:

* RetryAuthenticatedHttpClientHandler takes a Func<bool, Task<string>> so the
  token callback can be asked to force a full re-login instead of a renewal,
  and exposes TraceLog and FailureLog hooks for opt-in per-request diagnostics.
* New API areas: saved filters and filter preview/validation, communications,
  action confirmations, bonus points, appointment auto-planning, activity
  templates, appointments and calendars, background jobs, API keys, MCP
  clients, AI suggestions and chat history, and change-log/changes-since.

Package metadata now carries real authors and a description; 1.2.9 shipped
with NSwag placeholders.
title: Vertical Codes Bonder .net API Client
